_README: TEMPLATE — this file is never rendered. pr-icons copies it to the plugin root as icons.json,
fills in the placeholders, and passes THAT path as config_path on every MCP call.
Keys beginning with _ are documentation and must be deleted from the real icons.json.
FIRST, BEFORE WRITING ANY OF THIS: run preview_backgrounds(output_dir) and show the user
the contact sheet. They pick a fill style (gradient / solid / none) and a shape. The
defaults.background below is only a PLACEHOLDER — shipping it unchanged is how every
plugin ends up with the same blue blob nobody chose. See _styles for all four treatments.
Resolution order:  defaults < subcategories[sub] < components[i].
Anything omitted is inherited; set "background": {} on a component for no background at all,
or "background": { "shape": {...}, "icon": {} } to keep your own shape and drop an inherited
background icon. A component-level fg_color beats an inherited fg gradient.
Hand-made icon? Set "custom": true on the component: generate_icon skips it and never
overwrites Icons/[XX]_<Name>.png — you still run add_to_resources to embed it.
Run list_background_shapes() for the valid shape.type values, or preview_backgrounds() to
SEE them — they are the SVG filenames in this server's backgrounds/ folder, not a fixed
list in code.
Glyph placement is authored in each background SVG (a #ed1c24 rect), so you do NOT position
the foreground here. Use the optional per-icon "glyph" block only to override that box.
Some shapes (trapezoid, saddle-shape, database, l-border, quarter-circle-right,
right-triangle, half-circle) put the glyph partly outside the artwork by design — give those
a DARK fg_color, or a white glyph will disappear where it leaves the shape.

_note: The four background treatments, exactly as preview_backgrounds renders them.
Copy ONE of these in as a `background` block (at defaults, subcategory or component level).
Swap "rounded-square" for any slug from the contact sheet.

_none._effect: No background at all — the glyph alone, filling the canvas. Needs a dark fg_color.

_shape_plus_watermark._effect: Any shape above, with a second glyph washed in behind the foreground.

_paths: Both paths are relative to this file once it lives at the plugin root.
_choose: PLACEHOLDER — replace the background below with the style the user picked from the
contact sheet. Do not ship this value just because it renders.

plugin_icon._note: The 16x16 ribbon icon. Renders to [XX]_[PluginName]Logo, wired by pr-assembly.

[Subcategory]._note: One consistent background treatment per subcategory; the glyph carries the meaning.

components._note: Inherits everything from its subcategory; only the glyph differs.
components.name: [ComponentName]

components._note: No background — the glyph alone, filling the canvas.
components.name: [GlyphOnlyComponent]

components._note: Hand-made PNG already in Icons/ — never rendered or overwritten.
components.name: [HandMadeComponent]

components._note: Per-component overrides: own shape, gradient foreground, and a manual glyph box.
components.name: [SpecialComponent]
